strip-golden-chase.about: The default start at golden hour from the mid chase camera.

strip-golden-cockpit.about: The default start at golden hour from the driver's seat.

strip-night-cockpit.about: The default start at night with the headlights on, from the driver's seat.

town-noon-wagon.about: The wagon on a residential street at noon from the far chase camera.

strip-dusk-near.about: Dusk on the strip just after the street lamps come on (sun 7° down), headlights on, from the near chase camera.

town-map-full.about: The full-screen map at the default start: the whole town north-up with the player arrow.

coast-strip-golden.about: The procedural coast streamed round its start on the strip at golden hour from the far chase camera: the resident ring, the far terrain's hills behind it.

coast-traffic-noon.about: Busy NPC traffic at a signalized strip junction on the coast at noon, from the mid chase camera waiting at the stop line (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame).

coast-night-golden.about: The procedural coast's strip at night from the near chase camera, headlights on: sodium lamps with coronas, neon sign bands and blade signs, shop fills on the walks.

coast-traffic-night.about: Busy NPC traffic at the signalized strip junction of coast-traffic-noon at night, headlights on, from the mid chase camera waiting at the stop line: NPC low beams with coronas, glowing lamps (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame).

coast-traffic-dusk-chase.about: Busy NPC traffic on the coast highway at dusk from the mid chase camera, in the outer eastbound lane heading inland (traffic warmed up 20 s before the frame).

vehicle-select.about: The pause menu's Vehicle page at golden hour: the Regent on the turntable beside the panel, its paint swatches and specs.
